harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured opsadmin on node1 for key-only SSH access with the specified public key, verified working end-to-end (pubkey login succeeds, password login rejected), and completed the mandatory single-node restart with proof of changed boot identity and full post-restart recovery of the configuration.
actions_performed: Inspected existing sshd_config and confirmed no opsadmin user existed
Created opsadmin user, .ssh dir (700), authorized_keys (600) with the specified ed25519 key, locked the password (passwd -l)

Confirmed PasswordAuthentication no (via /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/60-cloudimg-settings.conf) and KbdInteractiveAuthentication no were already enforced globally; verified effective config for opsadmin via sshd -T -C
Generated missing SSH host keys (ssh-keygen -A) and /run/sshd since ssh.socket had never been triggered, validated config with sshd -t

Live-tested: added a temporary test keypair, confirmed pubkey login as opsadmin succeeds and password-only login is rejected (Permission denied (publickey)), then removed the temp key leaving only the required key
Captured pre-restart baseline (boot_id, uptime, authorized_keys, ssh.socket active)
Restarted node1 via backgrounded 'sudo reboot' so the ack returned before disconnect
Polled node1 until reachable again; confirmed boot_id changed (242af11e... -> bd1aec2e...)
Verified post-restart recovery: opsadmin user intact, authorized_keys intact with only the required key, sshd config settings unchanged, ssh.socket active
Re-validated end-to-end pubkey login post-restart with a second temporary test key, then removed it, leaving only the required key in authorized_keys

evidence.requirement: opsadmin user created with specified SSH public key configured
evidence.summary: opsadmin did not exist; created with home/.ssh and authorized_keys containing exactly the requested ed25519 key (verified final content matches exactly)
PasswordAuthentication no and KbdInteractiveAuthentication no confirmed both in config files and in sshd -T effective runtime evaluation for opsadmin

evidence.requirement: End-to-end proof key auth works and password auth is rejected
evidence.summary: SSH login as opsadmin with a test pubkey succeeded (PUBKEY_LOGIN_OK); SSH attempt forcing password auth was denied with 'Permission denied (publickey)'
Captured boot_id 242af11e-49fb-4e07-a001-8016b2349acb, uptime since 2026-09-29 11:16:02, authorized_keys content, and ssh.socket active status before restart

evidence.requirement: Node restart acknowledgement returned before disconnect
evidence.summary: Backgrounded 'sudo reboot' command returned REBOOT_SCHEDULED acknowledgement immediately

evidence.requirement: Node unreachable during restart, then boot identity changed
evidence.summary: Connection timed out mid-reboot, then reconnected with new boot_id bd1aec2e-7adc-474e-bdae-eb46b11d54f5 and fresh uptime 11:17:51, proving an actual reboot occurred

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of opsadmin SSH configuration and functionality
evidence.summary: After restart, opsadmin user, authorized_keys, and sshd password/kbd-interactive settings were all intact; live pubkey SSH login re-verified successful (POST_RESTART_PUBKEY_OK); final authorized_keys confirmed to contain only the required key

attempts.summary: Configured opsadmin on node1 for key-only SSH access with the specified public key, verified working end-to-end (pubkey login succeeds, password login rejected), and completed the mandatory single-node restart with proof of changed boot identity and full post-restart recovery of the configuration.
